hints.content:
Function $\redD g$ is shifted $2$ units left relative to $\blueD f$. 


[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A parabola f and its shifted graph g are on an x y coordinate plane. The x- and y- axes scale by one. Graph f is concave up and has a vertex around (one, negative one). Graph g is concave up and has a vertex around (negative one, negative one). An arrow points from point (one, negative one) to (negative one, negative one).

hints.content:
This means the value of $\redD{g}$ at a number $x$ is the same as the value of $\blueD{f}$ at a number $2$ more than $x$. 

  What would this sentence look like as an equation?

question.content:
